units.rawText: All this time, I've been relying on the use of colors to convey my thoughts. To me, words and actions are like fragile bubbles; they pop and vanish before they can be spoken or performed, leaving nothing but abstract blobs of pigment.

spans.text: All this time, I've been relying on the use of colors to convey my thoughts. To me, words and actions are like fragile bubbles; they pop and vanish before they can be spoken or performed, leaving nothing but abstract blobs of pigment.

units.rawText: But one day, you appeared among those pigments, Professor... You were the one who pieced together the colors of my heart again, turned them into a portrait, and then showed them to me.

spans.text: But one day, you appeared among those pigments, Professor... You were the one who pieced together the colors of my heart again, turned them into a portrait, and then showed them to me.

units.rawText: If I continue to keep you company, perhaps I might be able to share the colors hidden in my heart with more people someday... Don't you agree, Professor?
